new_page.description: Clayton, Cloverdale houses for sale: 34 listed in September 2026, monthly sales and how Clayton compares with Cloverdale. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Clayton Houses for Sale | Cloverdale Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Clayton. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Clayton, Cloverdale: 34 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 10 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 29%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 3 Cloverdale communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Cloverdale total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Clayton fell from 53 in June to 34 in September (−35.8%), and 36 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 16.9% of Cloverdale’s 201 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Clayton?
Clayton also had 96 condos and townhomes listed and 20 sold in September, against 34 houses listed. The Clayton condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Clayton home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

72 houses sold in Clayton with a median price of $1,295,000 (the middle half sold between $1,213,500 and $1,411,250), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $434 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median lot of 3,270 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Clayton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 34 houses listed in Clayton. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Clayton a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Clayton had a sales ratio of 29%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Clayton from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 36 houses sold in Clayton over those 4 months, out of 136 in all of Cloverdale.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Clayton?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Clayton sell for?
faq.a: 72 houses sold in Clayton between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,295,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Clayton?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (10% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
